scripts.build: vp run @vinext/cloudflare#build && vp run vinext#build && vp run create-vinext-app#build
scripts.check: vp check && node scripts/sync-next-types.mjs --check && node scripts/check-shim-types.mjs
scripts.vite-ecosystem-ci:before-install: pnpm config set frozen-lockfile false --location project
scripts.vite-ecosystem-ci:test: vp test run --project unit tests/build-optimization.test.ts tests/client-assets-build.test.ts && vp test run --project integration tests/app-router-rsc-plugin.test.ts tests/app-router-production-build.test.ts tests/vite-hmr-websocket.test.ts
scripts.postinstall: vp run @vinext/cloudflare#build && vp run vinext#build && vp run create-vinext-app#build && node scripts/typegen-workspaces.mjs
